issues.title: SSE Streaming Parse Logic Incomplete
issues.description: The SSE stream parsing extracts raw content but doesn't parse JSON payloads from the API. Server sends JSON but client concatenates raw strings.

issues.title: Missing Root Error Boundary
issues.description: Root layout lacks error boundary. Runtime errors crash entire app with no fallback UI.

issues.title: Test Failures Need Investigation
issues.description: 17 tests failing (94.8% pass rate) due to timeout errors in waitFor calls. Likely mock setup or async timing issues.
